title: Concept: MongoDB error detail disclosed in a response
description: A MongoDB duplicate key error that echoes the index and the value in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The message repeats the indexed value, so a response turns a uniqueness check into an oracle for whether a given national id or VPA is on file.
applicability: Deployments that render a MongoDB duplicate key error that echoes the index and the value into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The message repeats the indexed value, so a response turns a uniqueness check into an oracle for whether a given national id or VPA is on file.
